items.title: Newsletter Reboot
items.content_html:
I sent out the following message from my own domain to former subscribers to mark the reboot of the newsletter. I might send one more such note in a few weeks, depending on the response, but that will be it. The newsletter is opt-in.

Hello!

You once subscribed to emails from my blog at markstoneman.com. These stopped around 2021 or 2022, when my old host, Wordpress dot com, ruined that feature. I have finally restored this functionality to my blog at its current home, Micro dot blog.

The blog’s domain is the same; however, I will curate the newsletter on stoneman.page every week or two.

You can subscribe to the newsletter at stoneman.page/about, or simply reply to this email with your request. The newsletter itself will come from the host’s domain, in this case markstoneman@hello.micro.blog.

Best wishes,

Mark Stoneman

Historian, editor, and translator for hire (German to English)

🦣 @markstoneman.zirk.us
🦋 @markstoneman.com
